changelog:
[B][COLOR ff00fa9a]Version 2.0.36[/COLOR][/B]
[COLOR fffdb515]Usenet season packs[/COLOR]
-New: a season pack posted as one 7z archive, with all the episodes inside, now plays the episode you asked for. luc_kodi reads the real file names kept inside the archive, also when the names outside are hidden or only say the season. If the archive has no file for that episode, it says so and moves to the next NZB; it never plays a different episode.
-New: a 7z split into pieces with hidden names plays when the post numbers its pieces ([03/45]); without that order it is still refused, so no broken video is served.
-Fixed: a 7z whose first stored file is a .nfo or a picture no longer counts as compressed: the availability check keeps it and the film inside plays.
-Fixed: a 7z release is now served at the exact size of the video, without the archive's own bytes at the end.
-A season pack in a single RAR set only plays when the episode is its first file; otherwise it is skipped instead of playing another episode.
[COLOR fffdb515]Trakt read-only mode[/COLOR]
-New in Settings > Trakt: Read-only mode. luc_kodi keeps reading your watched status, lists, progress and resume points, but stops scrobbling and marking items watched on its own, so another add-on (for example the Trakt add-on) can report what you watch. Marking watched or unwatched by hand still works. Help is next to the setting.
[COLOR fffdb515]Resume[/COLOR]
-Fixed: when you choose Resume in Kodi's own prompt, luc_kodi no longer asks again with its own resume window. Plays started from a skin widget or an info screen keep your resume settings as before.
[COLOR fffdb515]Under the hood[/COLOR]
-Errors in the database, debrid, scraper and online service code no longer hide Kodi's shutdown request, and failed writes to the cache, the Trakt mirror and the source ranker are written to kodi.log instead of being lost silently.
-The add-on is 1.3 MB smaller: its pictures are stored more efficiently, with every pixel unchanged.
-Code tidied to the project's indentation rules, with no change in behaviour.
